method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Tobacco and Other Products Control Act 2006 (WA), compilation with editorial changes as at 14 May 2026, including the Tobacco Products Control Amendment Act 2026 (No. 1 of 2026; Pt. 2 in force 13 May 2026), as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/mrdoc_49390.txt (retrieved 7 September 2026). No regulations deposited: the s 30B(1) personal use, commercial and large commercial quantities, the s 15(1)(c) prescribed document and the ss 30A(3), 30B(6) therapeutic conditions are inputs.

scope: From the seat of the minor with a vape or tobacco: whether possession is an offence (s 30B) or only the sale and supply (ss 6, 30A) and look-alikes (s 106); buying and getting it (ss 7, 15(2)); proof of age (ss 12, 13, 15(1)); seizure, return or destruction, the duty to give details and telling a parent (ss 98-101); with the Glossary definitions they need and the tier 1 and tier 4 penalties. Licensing, advertising, display, smoking places, investigations, prosecutions and closure orders are out; the Act before 13 May 2026 is not deposited and is answered 'not answered'.
seat: the minor (a person under 18) with a vape or tobacco
